-- Check if results_summary has any data
SELECT * FROM results_summary;

-- Insert pilot sessions from pilot_sessions into measurements
INSERT INTO measurements (session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes)
SELECT session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, protocol_note
FROM pilot_sessions;

-- Verify the inserted data
SELECT session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, status FROM measurements WHERE session_id >= 'S100';

args.query:
-- Compute updated summary metrics for the analysis team
-- Add results_summary entries for all metrics including the newly integrated pilot data
SELECT 'total_measurements' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value, 'all' AS condition, COUNT(*) AS n, '2026-10-22' AS computed_at, 'p.harris' AS author
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mean_cognitive_score', ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 1), 'all', COUNT(*), '2026-10-22', 'p.harris'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'std_cognitive_score', ROUND(STDDEV(cognitive_score), 1), 'all', COUNT(*), '2026-10-22', 'p.harris'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mean_reaction_ms', ROUND(AVG(reaction_ms), 1), 'all', COUNT(*), '2026-10-22', 'p.harris'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'std_reaction_ms', ROUND(STDDEV(reaction_ms), 1), 'all', COUNT(*), '2026-10-22', 'p.harris'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mean_cognitive_score_rested', ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 1), 'rested', COUNT(*), '2026-10-22', 'p.harris'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mean_cognitive_score_sleep_deprived', ROUND(AVG(cognitive_score), 1), 'sleep_deprived', COUNT(*), '2026-10-22', 'p.harris';
